title: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns Agent Mistakes Into Lasting Lessons
abstract: arXiv:2610.31846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates. When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter. By keeping the original weights frozen, Self-Direction prevents adapter training from overwriting base-model parameters while training additional parameters equivalent to ~0.02% of the base model's parameter count for each adapter. The agent then saves these adapters in a persistent library

translated_title: 不要忘记你刚学到的东西：自我导向修复将智能体的错误转化为持久教训
translated_abstract: 智能体应当从错误中学习，从而使经验带来持续的改进。然而，当今的智能体从错误中恢复只是暂时的：上下文内的反思容易在会话之间被遗忘，并且会争夺有限的上下文空间，而全参数微调成本高昂，且可能干扰已有的能力。我们提出了Self-Direction（自我导向），这是一种让智能体从错误中学习的机制，它结合了临时性的上下文内重试与策略更新两者的优点。当智能体在任务中失败时，它会反思自己的行动轨迹以提取出一条教训，并立即将其提炼为一个轻量级的低秩适配器。通过保持原始权重冻结，Self-Direction防止了适配器训练对基础模型参数的覆盖，同时每个适配器仅需训练约相当于基础模型参数量0.02%的额外参数。随后，智能体会将这些适配器保存到一个持久化的库中。
tldr: 提出Self-Direction机制，让智能体在任务失败后自我反思提取教训，并立即蒸馏为轻量级低秩适配器（仅占基础模型约0.02%参数量）存入持久化库中，从而将错误转化为不遗忘、不破坏原有能力的持久化学习成果。
en_tdlr: Self-Direction enables agents to reflect on their failures, distill lessons into lightweight low-rank adapters (~0.02% of base model parameters) stored in a persistent library, turning mistakes into lasting improvements without overwriting base-model weights or forgetting across sessions.
